text:
mike: Quick question — how should the Console surface amortized cache savings per route? My proposal: show both absolute USD (sampled) and percent savings, default to percent, and add a toggle to reveal token counts + sampling confidence.

anna: I like defaulting to percent. Most PMs ask for relative impact first. Toggle is fine but needs an affordance in the hovercard, not buried under a menu. :point_up:

sara: Heads-up: to do per-route + per-variant amortization we need to emit model_variant_id and cache_fingerprint in telemetry. Right now ingest only has model_sku. Adding both increases cardinality — we should sample enriched events.

ben: Sampling sounds reasonable. Proposal: 1% enriched events with full lineage (variant + fingerprint + promptshape). Aggregated joins will estimate absolute tokens and USD. We can attach a sample_weight to reconstruct totals.

luis: Product preference: default view = percent savings + uncertainty band (from sampling). On hover show: tokens_saved_est ± CI, estimated_usd_saved, sample_rate. Also want a small "What changed" note when routing policy impacts numbers.

mike: Implementation notes: backend API change to /cost-preview should accept query param sample_rate and return { savings_pct, savings_usd_est, ci, sample_rate_applied, examples }. Minimal schema idea:```json
{
  "route": "string",
  "model_variant": "string",
  "savings_pct": 12.3,
  "savings_usd_est": 4.21,
  "ci": [3.9,4.5],
  "sample_rate": 0.01
}
```
Keep it simple for the first rollout.

anna: UX nit: can we show a "confidence" pill (low/med/high) instead of raw CI? Engineers can expand to see the CI. Also add a small tooltip: "Calculated from sampled lineage events."

sara: Agree on sampling. Ops note: enrich pipeline will need a fast path for hot routes to avoid adding latency to serving. We'll buffer enriched events to an async stream.

ben: Analytics will provide a reconciliation job to compare sampled estimates vs bill over last 7 days. If error > 10% we alert and increase sample_rate for that route automatically.

luis: Rollout UX: can we preview changes for canaries only? I want to show cost-preview for canary routing policy before full rollout so SREs can validate.

mike: We should wire the Console's rollout panel to call /cost-preview with the canary routing policy param. That way PMs/SREs get a simulated delta before flipping.

anna: Small checklist for the design PR: 1) percent-first layout 2) toggle to expand to tokens+usd 3) confidence pill + expand 4) tooltip copy 5) link to "how sampling works" doc.

sara: Ops checklist: 1) add model_variant_id + cache_fingerprint to telemetry schema 2) implement sampled enrichment (1% default) 3) async buffer + fast path 4) backfill flag for important customers.

ben: Analytics checklist: 1) reconciliation job 2) sample-weighted aggregation helpers 3) endpoint to request on-demand higher-sample-rate for a route (for investigation).

mike: Anyone object to the plan? If not I'll open the API + telemetry PRs and a Console mockup ticket. @anna pls own the hovercard copy.

luis: No objections. Owning the rollout preview flow.

anna: I'll draft hover copy after lunch, mockup in Figma by EOD.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/telemetry-sampling -> staging at 2024-10-02T18:20:00Z. /deploy status in #eng-platform when live. :rocket:

mike: Thanks everyone — I'll split the work into three PRs: telemetry schema, cost-preview API, console UX. We'll iterate on sample_rate defaults after reconciliation job runs. :thumbsup:
